$comment: The reviewed identity of the Windows build-input bundle (#236, W1-R). The publisher is TOLD what it may push; it does not publish whatever it happens to have built. W1-R-B compares the digest a trusted master build produces against this value and refuses on any difference, then verifies that the registry stored these exact manifest bytes. Regenerating the lock necessarily changes these digests — that is the point: a new toolchain is a new bundle and a new identity, never a mutation of this one.
$pathsComment: 499 files are delivered in the layer; manifest.sha256 lists the other 498 because it cannot list itself. The two-build comparison diffs manifest.sha256, so it reports 498.
publishedNote: NOT PUBLISHED. W1-R-A implements and validates only. The GHCR package does not exist until W1-R-B dispatches the publisher from trusted master and verifies the stored manifest.
